Maya: Quick heads-up 1: planning a mini 'Spotlight Stations' activation across offices in May to hand out spot-award kits and collect 1-question feedback. Need volunteers, shipping plan for remote folks, and a tiny tracking sheet. Thoughts? :star2:
Ethan: Love it. Which offices and how many kits each?
Maya: Tentative plan: SF (5/6-5/7) 180/day, NY (5/13) 140, Berlin (5/20) 100. Remote mailout target week of 5/27 for ~450 packages. Total ~1,050 incl buffer.
Rosa: What goes in a kit? are we including a cash-equivalent item?
Maya: Kit = hand-written note card, enamel pin, snack, QR postcard to the feedback form. No cash items. If any team wants a gift card for their winners we route through payroll.
Diego: I can run Berlin. For volunteers, do we do manager-only first hour then open signups? last time that flow worked.
Nina: yes manager setup + public volunteer slots. I'll make a signup form and add an "I can pack/address remote kits" checkbox.
op s_bot: FYI: International shipments under $45 usually avoid VAT in DE, but double-check on larger items. See policy: https://redwood-internal/people-ops/shipping-guidelines
Rosa: Procurement rec for vendor? we used ParcelWave previously for bulk drops. They did customs paperwork ok.
Ethan: I'll request a quote for 450 remote drops and overnight options.
Maya: Inventory owner? need SKU, qty ordered, qty received, packer initials, ship date, and tax-review flag if unit value > 150.
Diego: I'll own the inventory sheet and add a pack checklist column.
Nina: I'll add time slots: 09:00-11:00, 11:30-14:00, 14:30-17:00 and a notes field for accessibility.
Maya: Want a tiny ROI pulse: single question "Did this make your day? (yes/no)" with office param in URL for tracking. Use tiny.redwood/spot?o=SF etc.
Rosa: Also ask ops to capture number of kits given vs number of QR submissions so we can compute response rate.
Diego: For shipping labels, procurement wants a standardized import row: Name | Street | City | Region | Postal | Country | Phone | OrderRef
Nina: I'll add an "export-ready" tab to the sheet for that format.
Ethan: Comms: can we get a 2-line blurb + slack banner 1 week ahead of each office event? I'll draft and loop legal if we mention taxes.
Maya: Yes please. Also short post-event writeup (2-3 bullets) for the All Hands highlights.
Rosa: Tax note: if any individual redemption looks like cash-equivalent we need payroll to gross up. ops_bot can auto-flag > $150 values.
ops_bot: Heads-up: flagging rule applied to inventory sheet. See payroll integration doc: https://redwood-internal/payroll/gift-tax
Nina: Volunteer signup link (draft): https://forms.gle/spotlight-may (please test and add timezone info).
Diego: Inventory draft: https://docs.redwood/spotlight/inventory-2026 (edit for Diego, Maya, Nina).
Maya: Cool. Next steps: Nina finalizes signup by Friday, Ethan gets shipping quote by Tue, Diego completes inventory layout by Thu. Quick sync in Wednesday standup. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
